title: no-confirmed-compromise: 2 smaller precision and sourcing points
description: CISA KEV snapshot predates the patch release: The KEV file was fetched 08:16Z on 22 Oct but its catalogVersion 2026.10.21 was released 14:04:39Z on 21 Oct, minutes after the 14:00Z PHP release, so the absence of CVE-2026-109618/109619 says little. KEV also records exploitation, not a named victim. There is no text capture: the evidence is raw/known_exploited_vulnerabilities.20261022T0816Z.json (sha ef8fffed...). | Timeline says CERT.LV saw attempts "none successful": timeline.json (20:00Z event) says "automated attempts seen, none successful"; CERT.LV says only that there are no reports of successful attacks so far ("l_dz _im nav zi_u par sekm_giem uzbrukumiem"). Same nuance as this claim: absence of reports, not a finding of none.
